newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 21.375 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 21.375 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended steady in a balanced market, traders said on Wednesday.
"There is ample liquidity, overnight rates move in a narrow range and the market has regained composure," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.

Overnight rates closed at 21.375 percent after being traded between 21.25 and 21.50 percent. Tolonics added that present rates were likely to hold with the only uncertainty factor the tax-payment deadline on February 10.
